packageRules.description: A closed PR skips the version its title names. The default major title names only the major (`to v5`), so closing it would skip every later v5 release.
Major updates only, since group:allNonMajor holds every other update. Both packages pin a workerd version; one bumped without the other runs two runtimes.

Major updates only, since group:allNonMajor holds every other update. Each Start and router package depends on one exact `@tanstack/react-router` version; bumped apart, the app installs two copies of the router.
